Definition: probably from the same as G43; a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance):--weight.
BiblicalUsage: This weight appears once, in the race of Hebrews 12:1, where the writer tells believers to lay aside every weight and the sin that clings so closely, and run with endurance the race set before them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that some things are not sins in themselves but still slow me down, and faith means laying them aside so I can run free.
